class BothBranches {
  x;
  constructor(c: boolean) {
    if (c) this.x = 1;
    else this.x = 2;
  }
}

class Switched {
  x;
  constructor(k: number) {
    switch (k) {
      case 1:
        this.x = 10;
        break;
      default:
        this.x = 20;
    }
  }
}

class Throwing {
  x;
  constructor(c: boolean) {
    if (c) this.x = 1;
    else throw new Error("no value");
  }
}

class Ternary {
  x;
  constructor(c: boolean) {
    c ? (this.x = 1) : (this.x = 2);
  }
}

class DoOnce {
  x;
  constructor() {
    do {
      this.x = 3;
    } while (false);
  }
}

class Guarded {
  x;
  constructor(fail: boolean) {
    try {
      if (fail) throw new Error("fail");
      this.x = 4;
    } catch {
      this.x = 5;
    } finally {
      console.log("finally");
    }
  }
}

class Returned {
  x;
  constructor(c: boolean) {
    if (c) {
      this.x = 6;
      return;
    }
    this.x = 7;
  }
}

class Endless {
  x;
  constructor(limit: number) {
    for (let i = 0; ; i++) {
      if (i >= limit) {
        this.x = i;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

class Chained {
  x;
  y;
  constructor() {
    this.x = this.y = 8;
  }
}

class Fallthrough {
  x;
  constructor(k: number) {
    switch (k) {
      case 1:
        this.x = "one";
      default:
        this.x = "many";
    }
  }
}

class MaybeUndefined {
  x;
  constructor(c: boolean) {
    this.x = c ? 9 : undefined;
  }
}

const values: number[] = [
  new BothBranches(true).x,
  new BothBranches(false).x,
  new Switched(1).x,
  new Switched(2).x,
  new Throwing(true).x,
  new Ternary(false).x,
  new DoOnce().x,
  new Guarded(false).x,
  new Guarded(true).x,
  new Returned(true).x,
  new Returned(false).x,
  new Endless(3).x,
  new Chained().x + new Chained().y,
];
console.log(values.join(" "));
const text: string = new Fallthrough(1).x;
const maybe: number | undefined = new MaybeUndefined(false).x;
console.log(text, maybe);
